title: Invitation form
responsibility: Creates a project invitation and presents its link and one-time code for the owner to share.

inputs.name: InvitationForm.projectId
inputs.description: Required project identifier sent to the invitation operation. Authorization and invitation validity remain server responsibilities.

outputs.name: InvitationForm
outputs.description: Email and role form, initially Commenter, also offering Viewer. Trims email and blocks empty or concurrent submissions. On success shows the invitation link, code and expiry with separate-copy actions and a reminder that no email is sent here. Errors clear the invitation and appear as alerts. Clipboard failure gives manual-copy guidance; success shows a copied status.
